subject.title: feat(slack): allow configurable App Home views

question: Should the bundled Slack channel permanently expose `channels.slack.appHome.view` as a supported persisted configuration contract with account-level overrides?
rationale: The implementation is intentionally narrow, but accepting a new operator-facing config surface and its long-term compatibility obligation is a maintainer product decision rather than a mechanical code-review conclusion.

options.title: Accept the bundled Slack config contract
options.body: Keep the inline-only configuration design, subject to redacted live Slack publish and reload proof before merge.

options.title: Keep App Home fixed for now
options.body: Decline the new persisted setting and retain the existing built-in Home view until a broader Slack customization direction is sponsored.

recommendation.title: Accept the bundled Slack config contract
recommendation.body: Keep the inline-only configuration design, subject to redacted live Slack publish and reload proof before merge.
